description: Reads settleableUntil(id) for each roll and the head block, says the state of each (TROP_TOT: wait `blocsAvant` blocks; REGLABLE; PERDU: the 256-block window passed; PAS_EN_ATTENTE: already settled or expired), and returns one unsigned settleMany call for the settleable ones. Anyone may send it: the prize always goes to the player. REFUSED when no contract is served.
